chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): '[Quran 16:43]: So ask the People of the Reminder if you do not know.' He said: 'Al-Dhikr (the Reminder) is Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and we are his people, the ones to be asked.'

He (the narrator) said, I said: 'His word [Quran 43:44]: And it is indeed a Reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned?' He said: 'It means us, and we are the Ahl al-Dhikr (People of the Reminder), and we are the ones to be asked.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الذِّكْرِ: Ahl al-Dhikr: People of the Reminder — the Imams from the Prophet's household
key_terms.الذِّكْرُ: Al-Dhikr: The Reminder — refers here to the Prophet Muhammad himself, not merely the Quran
key_terms.الْمَسْؤُولُونَ: Al-Mas'ulun: The ones to be asked/consulted — those with religious authority

ai.seo_question: Who are the Ahl al-Dhikr (People of the Reminder) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith presents Imam al-Sadiq's (peace be upon him) exegesis of two Quranic verses concerning the 'Ahl al-Dhikr' (People of the Reminder). The narrator quotes Quran 16:43 and 43:44, and the Imam explains that 'al-Dhikr' in both verses refers to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), while the Ahl al-Dhikr are the Imams from his household, who are appointed by God as the authoritative source to be consulted in religious matters. This interpretation was significant in the context of the early Shia community, who needed authoritative guidance following the Prophet's passing, and the Imam's words establish the theological basis for the Imamate's religious authority.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Awrama, from Ali Bin Hassan, from his uncle Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘[16:43] so ask the People of the Reminder if you do not know. Heasws said: ‘Al-Zikr (The Reminder) is Muhammadsaww, and weasws are hissaww people, the onesasws to be asked’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [43:44] And it is a Reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned?’ Heasws said: ‘It Means usasws, and weasws are the Ahl Al-Zikr (The People of the Reminder), and weasws are the ones to be asked’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Uwarma from Ali ibn Hassa’n from his uncle ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir said that he asked I asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of the following words of Allah. “Ask the people of Dhikr if you do not know.” (16:43, 21: 7 Holy Quran) The Imams (a.s.) said, “Prophet Muhammad (s.a.) is ‘Dhikr’ and we are the people of ‘Dhikr who will be asked.”

I also asked about, “It is a Dhikr for you and for your people and you all will be asked questions.’ [43:44] The Imams (a.s.) said it is a reference to us. We are the people of Dhikr and we will be asked questions.”
